title.en: Talk about the birth before it is urgent
title.hi: Birth par baat kijiye, urgency se pehle

body.en: What she wants, what frightens her, what she wants you to do if a decision has to be made fast. This conversation is calm now and impossible later.
body.hi: Woh kya chahti hai, use kis se dar lagta hai, aur agar tezi se faisla lena pade toh woh aapse kya chahti hai. Yeh baat abhi shaant hai aur baad mein namumkin.
